description: Count tensor elements and list per-tensor sizes from supported model descriptors without loading a machine-learning framework. Static parsing within a 32 MiB combined input budget. No inference, Python imports or pickle execution. Reported compatibility is structural, not a guarantee a framework will load a model. ONNX counts stored initializers; it does not count runtime-generated tensors or prove which weights are trainable. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: model_params
title: Count model parameters
